cues.en: In 1996, Nintendo released a game that would change video games forever. Super Mario 64 was a landmark achievement. Many felt that 2D Mario was gaming perfection and that somehow the translation to 3D would dilute the experience. But the end result redefined the platforming genre and gave away to many 3D games that came after it. Oh, and it sold a cool 11 million copies.
cues.zh: 1996年，任天堂发布了一款将永远改变电子游戏的作品。Super Mario 64 是一项里程碑式的成就。许多人觉得2D Mario已是游戏性的完美形态，认为转向3D多少会稀释体验。但最终结果重新定义了平台跳跃类型，并为后来许多3D游戏开辟了道路。哦对了，它还卖出了足足1100万份。

cues.en: It showed off what the Nintendo 64 could do, complete with colorful 3D graphics that were fully texture mapped and filtered, exceptional audio, and of course, analog controls. It wasn't perfect. The game was criticized for its camera, which took some getting used to, but with the ability to adjust perspective, it certainly wasn't a major issue. And over 20 years later, Super Mario 64 still holds up. It's a masterpiece and a true killer app for the Nintendo 64.
cues.zh: 它展示了 Nintendo 64 的实力：色彩丰富的3D图形、完整的纹理映射与过滤、出色的音频，当然还有模拟控制。它并不完美。游戏的镜头受到批评，需要一些时间适应，但既然能调整视角，这当然不算大问题。而20多年后，Super Mario 64 依然站得住脚。它是一款杰作，也是 Nintendo 64 真正的杀手级应用。

cues.en: Mario 64 was first playable in emulation as early as 1999, and for years people have been interested in dissecting the game to learn more of its secrets. One particular method involved the generation of source code for the entire game. In the middle of 2019, the source code for Super Mario 64 was released onto the internet. However, this was not a leak of the official source code to the game.
cues.zh: Mario 64 早在 1999 年就能在模拟器上玩了，多年来人们一直想剖析这款游戏，了解更多秘密。其中一种方法涉及生成整个游戏的源代码。2019 年年中，Super Mario 64 的源代码被发布到网上。不过，这并不是游戏官方源代码的泄露。

cues.en: Rather, it was a decompilation project that was performed painstakingly over many, many months. For those that may not be familiar, with decompilation and reverse engineering tools like IDA Pro or even better, Ghidra, which is free and open source, it's actually possible to generate raw C code from the binary. The tools are that good. So let's take a quick pause. Why do we care about any of this?
cues.zh: 相反，这是一个反编译项目，耗费了数月时间才艰难完成。可能有人还不熟悉，借助 IDA Pro 甚至更好的 Ghidra（免费且开源）这类反编译和逆向工程工具，其实可以从二进制文件中生成原始 C 代码。这些工具就是这么强。所以先暂停一下。我们为什么要在意这些？

cues.en: There was a recent video made by fellow YouTuber MattKC, who made a very interesting discovery that Super Mario 64 could actually run faster with a simple one-line change to a file. I recommend checking out his video on this topic and I'll have a link in the description below.
cues.zh: 同为 YouTuber 的 MattKC 最近发了个视频，有个很有趣的发现：只要对文件做简单的一行改动，《Super Mario 64》居然就能跑得更快。推荐去看看他关于这个的视频，链接我会放在下方简介里。

cues.en: So before we get technical, let's see if any of this is actually true. This is running on real hardware with an Everdrive cartridge. The speed-ups are very apparent on the level Dire Dire Docks. And indeed, if we compare the patched optimized version to the unmodified original game, there is a performance increase. Doing some quick frame rate analysis shows this as well. This is pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 所以在深入技术细节之前，我们先看看这些说法到底是不是真的。这是在实机上用 Everdrive 烧录卡运行的。在 Dire Dire Docks 这一关，提速非常明显。而且确实，把打过补丁的优化版和未修改的原版游戏对比，性能有提升。做个快速的帧率分析也能看出这一点。这挺有意思的。

cues.en: As you can see, the patched, optimized version can run significantly faster, frequently hitting 30 frames per second. The unmodified original version is notorious for slowdown and lag on the di-di-dox level, and as you can see, it sometimes struggled to keep up, and it will bottom out at sometimes less than 20 frames per second.
cues.zh: 如你所见，打过补丁的优化版本运行速度明显更快，经常能跑到每秒 30 帧。未修改的原版在 diddy-dox 关卡上出了名地会掉速、卡顿，如你所见，它有时很难跟上，帧率最低时会掉到每秒 20 帧以下。

cues.en: So this was all achieved by utilizing Ghidra, a decompilation and reverse engineering tool. If we provide Ghidra with a Mario 64 ROM, it will decompile the ROM successfully and generate raw seed code. However, the function names will be generic, which aren't that useful because there is no context. So the next step from here is to update the code to understand what it's actually doing. The Mario 64 decompilation project is the work of many, many months of research and development.
cues.zh: 这一切都是借助 Ghidra 实现的，它是一个反编译和逆向工程工具。如果把马里奥 64 的 ROM 交给 Ghidra，它能成功反编译这个 ROM，并生成原始种子代码。不过，函数名都会是通用名称，由于缺乏上下文，这些名字不太有用。所以下一步就是更新代码，弄清它实际在做什么。马里奥 64 反编译项目是许多人经过大量时间研究和开发才完成的成果。

cues.en: but in the end, the project is capable of generating a Mario 64 ROM file that exactly matches byte for byte the US version of the game. That's pretty impressive. There's never any guarantee of that, but it shows how good decompilation techniques have become. So let's go back to that one-line change. It was performed in a file that was known as a Makefile. This is a file which contains a list of instructions to tell the MIPS C compiler how to build the ROM.
cues.zh: 但最终，这个项目能够生成一个 Mario 64 ROM 文件，并且与游戏美版逐字节完全一致。这相当了不起。虽然从来没有人能保证做到这一点，但它说明了反编译技术已经变得多么出色。那么让我们回到那处一行改动。它是在一个名为 Makefile 的文件中进行的。这个文件包含一系列指令，用来告诉 MIPS C 编译器如何构建 ROM。

cues.en: It also contains information about the optimization settings that it should apply when building a release candidate for the game. Recall that the original US Mario 64 ROM matches the Decompolations Project ROM byte for byte based on the makefile. So as it turns out, we can see that there was no optimization flag enabled before the game went retail. So this is the part that seems very strange. Nintendo for some reason decided to release Mario 64 in the USA without any optimization at all.
cues.zh: 它还包含在构建该游戏的发布候选版本时应应用的优化设置信息。回想一下，根据 makefile，原始美版 Mario 64 ROM 与 Decompolations Project 的 ROM 逐字节一致。结果我们发现，在游戏正式发售之前，没有启用任何优化选项。所以这部分显得非常奇怪。任天堂出于某种原因，决定在美国发售完全没有任何优化的 Mario 64。

cues.en: What this makefile is telling us is that the European version is running an optimization known as O2. While the North American version is not running optimization at all, in fact, minus G means to generate debug output.
cues.zh: 这个 makefile 告诉我们，欧洲版启用了名为 O2 的优化。而北美版根本没有启用优化；事实上，-g 的意思是生成调试输出。

cues.en: So is Super Mario 64 not optimized at all in the US version? That has been the source of the recent discussion point. That somehow Mario 64 fell through the cracks when it was being released in the USA without any optimization. And as soon as I heard about the story, I was immediately skeptical. Before we throw our hands up in the air and blame Nintendo for being lazy, let's do some digging and see if there's a logical explanation for all this.
cues.zh: 那么，美版 Super Mario 64 真的完全没有优化吗？这正是最近讨论的焦点。说是 Mario 64 在美国发行时被漏掉了，完全没做优化。我一听到这个说法，立刻表示怀疑。在我们摊手放弃、责怪任天堂偷懒之前，先来挖一挖，看看这一切是否有合乎逻辑的解释。

cues.en: As someone who is a C program and has many years of C programming experience, this story really perked my interest because the initial takeaway is Nintendo somehow managed to omit the O2 optimization on Super Mario 64, but...
cues.zh: 作为一个有多年 C 编程经验的 C 程序员，这个故事真的引起了我的兴趣，因为初步结论是 Nintendo 不知怎么居然在 Super Mario 64 上漏掉了 O2 优化，但……

cues.en: I think it's important to really deep dive and understand how optimization works on C compilers, as well as take a look at some of the development documents from Nintendo back in 1996. When you develop code in C, the compiler will do its best to optimize it for you, but there are some additional levels of optimization that you can also apply. They are O0,
cues.zh: 我觉得很有必要深入探究并理解 C 编译器中的优化是如何工作的，也看看 Nintendo 在 1996 年的一些开发文档。当你用 C 写代码时，编译器会尽力为你优化，但还有一些你可以额外应用的优化级别。它们是 O0，

cues.en: or no optimization. This is the equivalent of having the flag omitted. This option is not recommended except for debugging purposes. Next is O1. This is a basic optimization level. The compiler tends to produce smaller code. O2 is a step up from O1 and it's the recommended level of optimization in most instances. It will increase code performance quite nicely.
cues.zh: 也就是不优化。这相当于省略该标志。除非为了调试，否则不建议使用这个选项。接下来是 O1。这是基础优化级别。编译器倾向于生成更小的代码。O2 比 O1 更进一步，在大多数情况下是推荐的优化级别。它能相当明显地提升代码性能。

cues.en: Then there is 03, which is the highest level. It's aggressive and it's known to break code. Its usage is not recommended, however, the gains can be significant. So let's consider this piece of code here. It's a simple mem copy function that takes a source and copies it to a destination. It's not really important to understand the assembly language that it's generating on the right hand side, but notice that it's generating around 52 lines of assembly from the basic mem copied C function.
cues.zh: 然后是 03，也就是最高级别。它很激进，而且已知会破坏代码。不推荐使用，不过带来的收益可能很显著。所以来看看这段代码。它是一个简单的 mem copy 函数，接收源地址并复制到目标地址。右侧生成的汇编语言其实不太重要，但注意，这个基础的 mem copy C 函数生成了大约 52 行汇编。

cues.en: If we specify that we want O2 as our optimization pattern, you can see that the assembly code is significantly reduced. In general terms, less assembly instructions means faster code. So, it's 1996. Nintendo is about to launch the Nintendo 64 with Mario 64 in the US. And we're led to believe that somehow, they forgot to...
cues.zh: 如果我们指定 O2 作为优化模式，可以看到汇编代码显著减少。一般来说，汇编指令越少，代码运行越快。时间来到 1996 年。任天堂即将在美国推出 Nintendo 64 和《Mario 64》。而我们被引导相信，他们不知怎么忘了……

cues.en: add the O2 optimization flag to the US version of the game. Now, the developer in me tells me that there is more to this story than meets the eye. So this is the programming guide and reference manual. If you were a developer from the Nintendo 64, you'd be quite familiar with this documentation. Pretty much all the information you need to code N64 games is here.
cues.zh: 给美国版游戏加上 O2 优化标志。作为开发者的直觉告诉我，事情没那么简单。这就是编程指南和参考手册。如果你是 Nintendo 64 开发者，会对这份文档相当熟悉。编写 N64 游戏所需的信息几乎都在这里。

cues.en: Back in the early days, developers were using silicon graphics workstations, and then later partnered Nintendo 64 hardware development kits on PCs, and writing code in C. Many developers came from the Super Nintendo, where things were done using assembly language, so there was a bit of a learning curve here. C has some intricacies and pitfalls, particularly around typecasting, that can catch you out if you're not careful, and then adding optimizations into the mix can easily break code.
cues.zh: 早期，开发者用的是 Silicon Graphics 工作站，后来在 PC 上配合 Nintendo 64 硬件开发套件，并用 C 写代码。很多开发者来自 Super Nintendo 时代，那时都用汇编语言做事，所以这里有点学习曲线。C 有一些复杂之处和陷阱，尤其是类型转换方面，不小心就会中招；再把优化掺进来，很容易把代码搞坏。

cues.en: Looking through the online documentation came up with some interesting bits of information. Nintendo themselves recommended that any non-debug code is compiled with the O2 optimization flag. In fact, looking at the samples that came with the SDK further proves that O2 should have been the target. So why was it omitted in Mario 64? Simply because Mario 64 was a launch title, development kit hardware was expensive, the tools and the SDK was not yet established,
cues.zh: 查阅在线文档时发现了一些有意思的信息。任天堂自己建议，所有非调试代码都要用 O2 优化标志编译。事实上，看看 SDK 附带的示例，就进一步证明了 O2 本该是目标配置。那为什么《超级马力欧 64》里把它省略了？原因很简单：马力欧 64 是首发作品，开发机硬件很贵，工具和 SDK 当时也还没成熟，

cues.en: and there is strong evidence that points to compiler issues that were later patched.
cues.zh: 而且有强有力的证据指向后来才被修补的编译器问题。

cues.en: For example, one particular one that stands out is back-to-back floating point multiplication. That is, if you multiply two floating point numbers, then take the result of the first multiplication, and then multiply that with another number, it could provide incorrect results. Now, this may seem harmless, but incorrect math floating point values would likely affect geometry and textures. Attempting to track down and fix these types of bugs can take many, many hours to triage and resolve. Nintendo offered a software workaround and later patched it.
cues.zh: 例如，一个特别突出的例子是连续的浮点乘法。也就是说，如果你把两个浮点数相乘，再拿第一次乘法的结果去乘另一个数，就可能得到错误结果。这看起来可能无害，但错误的浮点运算结果很可能影响几何体和纹理。要追踪并修复这类 bug，可能需要花上很多很多小时来排查和解决。Nintendo 提供了一个软件规避方案，后来又发布了补丁。

cues.en: During the development of Mario 64, it's likely that optimization was disabled, so developers could be in control of this issue. There's also other interesting things. Looking at the SDK patch notes can reveal some additional information. This particular patch note was from late 1996. Essentially what it's saying is if O2 was enabled, any warning that the compiler would spit out is suppressed. In other words, if there's a chance that the compiler will generate bugs and inform the dev, they'll never see it.
cues.zh: 在开发 Mario 64 期间，优化很可能被关闭了，这样开发者就能掌控这个问题。还有其他有意思的地方。查看 SDK 补丁说明还能发现一些额外信息。这条补丁说明来自 1996 年末。它本质上是在说，如果启用了 O2，编译器吐出的任何警告都会被屏蔽。换句话说，就算编译器可能产生 bug 并通知开发者，他们也永远看不到。

cues.en: Again, something that was later addressed, but Mario 64 was a launch game, and developers wanted full control over their code and not risk it. The main takeaway here is that Mario 64 was developed with early versions of the STK that contained bugs. Dylan Cuthbert, who worked with Nintendo on the Super NES and Nintendo 64, also confirmed that O2 and even O3 introduced problems for developers that were not familiar with C compilers.
cues.zh: 再说，这个问题后来得到了处理，但 Mario 64 是首发游戏，开发者希望完全掌控自己的代码，不想冒这个险。这里的主要结论是，Mario 64 是用含有 bug 的早期版本 STK 开发的。曾与任天堂在 Super NES 和 Nintendo 64 上合作的 Dylan Cuthbert 也证实，O2 甚至 O3 会给不熟悉 C 编译器的开发者带来问题。

cues.en: There is one more interesting piece of information that I want to share with you guys about this story, and that is it's easy to conclude that Nintendo did not optimize Mario 64 in the US. However, that is not entirely true. Although the O2 flag does help Super Mario 64, the gains aren't massive. The difference between debug and O2 normally is fairly significant.
cues.zh: 关于这个故事，我还想和大家分享一个有趣的信息：很容易得出“任天堂在美国没有优化 Super Mario 64”的结论。但这并不完全正确。虽然 O2 标志确实对 Super Mario 64 有帮助，但收益并不大。通常 debug 和 O2 之间的差异相当显著。

cues.en: There's two things going on here. First, O2 won't help with the GPU, and second, and perhaps more importantly, the discovery that O2 was not enabled is not 100% accurate. In fact, you could say it's a little misleading. Most Nintendo 64 games that were developed would use a common library known as Lib Ultra, and developers of games would build common libraries that were shared across their titles.
cues.zh: 这里有两件事。第一，O2 对 GPU 没有帮助；第二，也许更重要的是，“O2 未启用”这个发现并不完全准确。事实上，可以说它有点误导。大多数开发中的 Nintendo 64 游戏会使用一个叫 Lib Ultra 的通用库，而游戏开发者也会构建在其各款作品中共享的通用库。

cues.en: Mario 64 uses Lib Ultra and other libraries to handle math, audio, and additional calculations. If we go back to the make file we saw earlier, but scroll down further, there are libraries that are also compiled into the game, but most of them have O2 and even O3 enabled. It means, while some of the source indeed isn't optimized, the libraries that work with the game well and truly are, and referencing these makes up a large part of the game. So how does a true debug
cues.zh: Mario 64 使用 Lib Ultra 和其他库来处理数学、音频以及额外计算。如果我们回到之前看到的 make 文件，但继续往下滚动，还有一些库也会被编译进游戏，不过它们大多数启用了 O2 甚至 O3。这意味着，虽然有些源码确实没有优化，但那些与游戏配合良好的库确实经过了优化，而引用这些库构成了游戏的很大一部分。那么，真正的调试版

cues.en: or non-optimized Mario 64 run. Well let's go ahead and disable optimization from every single source file in this code and see how well it performs now. As you can see on the intro screen on the left hand side is the debug version and there's already a few frames per second difference. It's a lot slower. The O2 and base versions run at around the same level of performance. So the O2 version isn't really any more optimized than the base version only in select places.
cues.zh: 或者未优化的 Mario 64 又是怎么运行的。好，我们继续把这个代码里每个源文件的优化都关掉，看看现在性能如何。如你所见，在开场画面上，左边是调试版，已经差了好几帧每秒。它慢了很多。O2 版和基础版的性能大致相同。所以 O2 版实际上并不比基础版更优化，只是个别地方有优化。

cues.en: So in conclusion, Nintendo certainly did not forget to optimize Super Mario 64. They knew exactly what they were doing, given the tools that they had to work with at the time. All things considered, the game turned out to be an absolute masterpiece and performed exceptionally well. Back in those days, we weren't as concerned about frame rates and lag as we are now.
cues.zh: 总而言之，任天堂肯定没有忘记优化 Super Mario 64。考虑到当时手头可用的工具，他们完全清楚自己在做什么。总的来说，这款游戏最终成了一部绝对的杰作，表现也非常出色。在那个年代，我们并不像现在这样在意帧率和卡顿。

cues.en: Pilot Wings was another game that had slowdowns. You'd play through the game and then all of a sudden the game would basically have its frame rate. So I'm not suggesting that this is a similar type of thing, but it could be something that would benefit from a decompilation and another look at the code to see if there's any modern techniques that can be applied in order to improve performance. And I think that type of
cues.zh: Pilot Wings 也是一款会出现掉帧的游戏。你玩着玩着，游戏会突然……帧率就那样了。所以我并不是说这属于类似的情况，但它或许能从反编译中受益，重新审视代码，看看有没有可以应用来提升性能的现代技术。而我觉得这类

cues.en: project work or that type of you know Discoveries are very interesting to me. So there's definitely more
cues.zh: 项目工作，或者那类你知道的发现，对我来说非常有意思。所以肯定还有更多

cues.en: things there that I'm very excited to see and hopefully more decompilation project teams start to rally around and get more of these projects decompiled so we can start looking at them and and really applying modern compilation techniques to some of the things that we're trying to do in order to increase performance. Well guys I'm going to leave it here for this video thank you so much for watching if you liked it you know what to do leave me a thumbs up and as always don't forget to like and subscribe and I'll catch you guys in the next video bye for now
cues.zh: 那里的东西让我非常期待，也希望更多反编译项目团队能聚集起来，把更多这类项目反编译出来，这样我们就能开始研究它们，并真正把现代编译技术应用到我们正在尝试的一些事情上，以提升性能。好了各位，这个视频就到这里，非常感谢观看。如果喜欢，你知道该怎么做，给我点个赞；一如既往，别忘了点赞和订阅，我们下个视频见，拜拜。
